title: 1995 FPG Aquanaught #46 Jeff Easley Fantasy Art Trading Card
descriptionText: The product is a vintage 1995 Aquanaught trading card from the Jeff Easley FPG Fantasy Art series. This non-sport trading card features fantasy artwork of the Aquanaught character, making it a sought-after collectible for fans of fantasy and trading card enthusiasts. The card number is 46 in the series, adding to its rarity and value as a collectible piece from the 1990s.
